author: kirubaharan181
description: Use when starting or standardizing repos: branching, environment, coding rules. Do NOT use for enterprise audit or application code.
purpose: Gives teams a safe, repeatable engineering baseline: protected repositories, branching rules, reproducible environments, coding standards, configuration and secrets handling. It owns stages 45-52 and the repository-level controls that other skills rely on.
when_to_use: A repository, branching model or development environment must be set up.
Coding standards, configuration or secrets handling need defining and enforcing.
Repository controls must be checked for drift.
when_not_to_use: Organization-wide audit and policy: use enterprise-governance.
prerequisites: Repository platform access at the level needed to read or change settings.
A decision on language and tooling, or a request to propose one.
A secrets store, or a stated plan for one.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.

required: repository or project name and owners

outputs: repository with README, licence, code owners and protection

decision_rules.situation: Main branch can be pushed to directly
decision_rules.action: Enable protection requiring review and passing checks.

decision_rules.situation: A secret is found in the repository
decision_rules.action: Revoke and rotate first, then clean history per policy.

decision_rules.situation: Rules exist only in a document
decision_rules.action: Enforce them in settings or CI.

quality_gates: A newcomer can build and run from the README
Secrets are not in the repository
Formatter and linter run in CI and block on errors

examples.title: Set up a new repository
examples.request: Create the repository for the notifications service.
examples.context: Team of six, weekly releases, Python.
examples.behavior: Create it with README, licence and code owners, protect main, add CI, enable secret scanning and grant team access.
examples.output: Repository checklist with settings evidence and a clean-checkout build result.
examples.acceptance: Fresh clone builds with documented commands.

examples.title: Remove a committed secret
examples.request: A scanner found a token in the repository.
examples.behavior: Mark the action as needing human approval for rotation, advise revoking first, then plan history clean-up.
examples.output: Incident note with revoke, rotate and clean-up steps and owner.
examples.acceptance: Token revoked before any clean-up; no secret value appears in the note.

limitations: Cannot change platform settings without access; it will list the required changes instead.
Rotation of production secrets needs human approval.
Cannot verify that a rule is followed in other repositories without access to them.

troubleshooting.resolution: Ask an owner for read access or the exported settings.

troubleshooting.error: Setup steps fail on a clean machine
troubleshooting.resolution: Pin versions, fix the guide and retest.
Apply it in a separate commit with no other changes.
